title: Workout Clamp All
prompt: A workout chart must keep every rep count inside a visible range. Write a function that returns a new array where values below min become min and values above max become max.

explanation.beginner:
Example: workoutClampAll([-4,8,25], 1, 20) produces [1,8,20]. Apply both bounds so values inside the interval remain unchanged and outliers move to the nearest permitted bound.

Compare “keeps values inside the range”: input [[1,8],1,20] produces [1,8]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
